name: atsy
description: Free ATS CV scanner — see your CV the way a hiring machine sees it

scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 dev --var OTP_ECHO:1 --var TURNSTILE_BYPASS:1
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npx playwright test --config playwright.config.js
scripts.tour: npm run build && TOUR=1 npx playwright test --config playwright.config.js tests/e2e/tour.spec.js
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy
